articles.title: CLARITY Act failure could send crypto valuations lower: Bernstein
articles.description: Bernstein said Congress’ failure to pass the CLARITY Act’s could trigger another leg down for crypto valuations and accelerate policy support from US regulators.

articles.title: Bitget set to exit Japan, close all remaining positions by year-end
articles.description: The crypto trading platform, ranked fifth on CoinGecko, stopped accepting new registrations on Sunday and plans to shut down all remaining positions by Dec. 31.
